note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Modeled today: skill1 = a continuous self Shield worth 40.12% of final Max HP from t=0 (the 'Struggle' status carrier, no durationSec); burst = a self Shield-recovery of 15.04% of final Max HP gated on the owner holding a shield (`requiresShielded`, the Struggle proxy — always satisfied at scope), plus the kit's only offensive line, Sustained damage ▲ 10.16% to all allies including self for 10 s on her own burst cast. skill2 is deliberately EMPTY: all three of its lines hang off triggers the engine cannot express (a taunt after 60 landed normals, and two part-destruction riders) against a boss with no destructible parts — they are recorded verbatim-in-substance in `unmodeled` rather than approximated with an invented trigger. Both 'not in Struggle status' branches are likewise unmodelable (no inverse shield gate) and unreachable, since nothing in v1 removes a shield. This unit carries no direct damage, no weapon-state modifier, and no ATK/crit/core buff; its board footprint is the single Sustained-damage team buff and its interaction with any teammate that consumes shield events.
